title: Sensor-Set Conditioning for Prognostic Posterior Consistency
description: Versioned reproducibility archive for the manuscript and its frozen evaluation artifacts. The archive contains the manuscript source, the formal protocol and claim-metric contracts, frozen thresholds and decision snapshots, compact calibration and C-MAPSS shared-model results, and the scripts needed to regenerate the compact analyses. The primary study uses a controlled synthetic benchmark with exact oracle posteriors; C-MAPSS FD001 is included as a public simulated benchmark and is not presented as field validation. Raw C-MAPSS files, large prediction stores, and private checkpoints are excluded.
notes: The DOI should be minted from the versioned GitHub release after the repository is connected to Zenodo. Select the final code-and-manuscript license in the Zenodo deposit form before publication.
